name: dsh-memory-win
description: Windows-first long-term memory for the DSH desktop app: plain markdown shards with a per-step map injection (path / entry count / latest date / keywords) and on-demand retrieval through the memory_search tool. Zero shell, zero external process, zero dependency — roots resolve at call time from DSH_HOME/homedir so the global layer cannot silently vanish on Windows, and memory is split into a global layer plus a per-project layer (inside the repo) plus named shards under each.
